metadata.title: लालच-लूट पेसा को कमज़ोर कर रहा है | Why PESA is diluted in Jharkhand | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Main Bhi Bharat brings an exclusive interview with prominent tribal rights activist Gladson Dungdung, who has been at the forefront of the movement opposing the Jharkhand government’s recent rules under the PESA Act, 1996. In this candid conversation, Dungdung raises serious concerns over the alleged dilution of PESA in Jharkhand, which he argues threatens the autonomy of gram sabhas and weakens the rights of Adivasi communities over their land and resources. He highlights how the new rules could lead to greater bureaucratic interference and undermine the spirit of self-governance that PESA aims to achieve. Dungdung also sheds light on the historical significance of the Act and why tribal communities see it as a vital tool to protect their identity, culture, and natural resources. This interview offers deep insights into the ongoing debate and the potential impact of the government’s move on tribal rights and empowerment in the state.
